title: Pukka Juice 5000+ Berry Frenzy 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pukka Juice 5000+ Berry Frenzy Nic Salt e-liquid delivers an explosion of juicy berry flavours, blending sweet Blueberries, tangy Raspberries, and the bold taste of Cherries and Cranberries. This well-rounded fusion of berries offers a perfectly balanced fruity vape that is as vibrant as it is satisfying. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, Pukka Juice 5000+ Nic Salts are ideal for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) vape kits and pod devices, offering smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine relief. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this e-liquid is perfect for vapers seeking a rich and flavourful vaping experience. Pukka Juice, an award-winning UK brand, is renowned for its creative and flavour-packed e-liquids. The Pukka Juice 5000+ collection brings disposable-style flavours into a versatile e-liquid format, ideal for reusable vape kits. Try other exciting flavours like Blue Razz Gummy, Blackcurrant Menthol, and Pineapple Ice.
